_help: DEFAULT VALUES. Edit a number here, then restart the game. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
To keep your edits separate from these defaults, put just the keys you change in config.json instead;
config.json is applied last and wins. Load order: built-in values -> defaults.json -> config.json.
Keep valid JSON (commas between lines, none after the last). If a file is broken, it is skipped.
Challenges use their own starting animals, so start_rabbits / start_foxes only affect the sandbox.
Test a change without playing:  python tests/balance.py 20 1000 fox_detect_radius=5
Fox Hunger slider multiplies fox_detect_radius (fox vision). Babies sliders multiply the *_repro_prob values.
